portalPrivacy.controllerBody: is the controller of the personal data you provide when applying to its openings. TIMS ATS is the technology platform the organization uses to manage its recruitment processes and acts as a data processor on its behalf.
portalPrivacy.dataBody: Identification and contact data (name, email, phone, location), professional information (title, company, experience, LinkedIn profile), your cover message and, if you attach it, your resume.
portalPrivacy.purposeBody: Managing your participation in the organization's recruitment and selection processes: assessing your profile, contacting you about the process and keeping your application as a record of it.
portalPrivacy.rightsBody: Under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, you can access, update and correct your data, request proof of the authorization you gave, be informed about how your data is used, file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce, revoke the authorization and request deletion of your data, and access it free of charge.
portalPrivacy.exerciseBody: Contact the organization through its official contact channels stating your name, the email you applied with and your request.
portalPrivacy.baseNotice: This notice is the platform's baseline policy. The organization may have its own data processing policy that complements it.

fitWeights.explainer: A candidate's FIT score combines several dimensions. A weight profile sets how much each one counts; a vacancy uses the profile of its role family and, without one, the "Default" profile (equal weights). Dimensions with no data for a candidate are left out and their weight is shared among the others.

rejectCandidateModal.confirmNoEmail: No email will be sent to the candidate.
rejectCandidateModal.confirmWithEmail: The candidate will receive a neutral email; it does not mention the reason or the internal note.
rejectCandidateModal.bulkDescription: The selected applications will leave the active pipeline and appear in "Rejected". The reason, note and notification apply to all of them.
rejectCandidateModal.bulkConfirmDesc: You are rejecting {n} candidates for the reason "{reason}". The applications move to "Rejected" and cannot be reactivated.
rejectCandidateModal.successNotified: Candidate rejected. The notification email will be sent.
rejectCandidateModal.notNotifiedConsent: Candidate rejected. No email was sent: they revoked the authorization to process their data.
rejectCandidateModal.notNotifiedFailed: Candidate rejected. The notification email could not be sent.
rejectCandidateModal.bulkPartial: {ok} of {total} candidates rejected; {failed} could not be rejected (reload the board).
rejectCandidateModal.bulkNotNotified: {n} candidates did not get the email (they revoked the authorization or the send failed).

interviewTranscription.noticeBody: If the candidate agrees, you can start a transcript of the call: text only, no audio or video is recorded. The AI may suggest evidence and ratings; the decision is yours.
interviewTranscription.noticeCheckbox: I have read the notice and agree that my participation is transcribed if transcription is started.
interviewTranscription.noticeRequired: Accept the notice to join the call.
interviewTranscription.ackFailed: Your acceptance could not be recorded: you can stay in the call, but not start the transcript.
interviewTranscription.candidatePending: The candidate has not answered the transcription notice yet.
interviewTranscription.candidateAccepted: The candidate agreed to the transcription.
interviewTranscription.candidateDeclined: The candidate did not agree to the transcription. The interview continues without it.
interviewTranscription.statusUnavailable: The transcription status could not be loaded.
interviewTranscription.errorCandidateConsent: The candidate did not agree to the transcription. The interview can continue without it.
interviewTranscription.errorAcknowledgement: Accept the transcription notice first (go back to the waiting room).
interviewTranscription.errorNoRoom: Transcription only works in the platform's video room.
interviewTranscription.errorClosed: This interview is no longer in progress.
interviewTranscription.errorProvider: The transcription could not start. Check that the candidate is in the call and try again.
interviewTranscription.errorGeneric: The action could not be completed. Try again.
interviewTranscription.aiExplain: The AI summarizes the conversation and quotes the candidate verbatim. Check every quote before using it; the AI does not decide for you.
interviewTranscription.notReady: The transcript will be available when the call ends.
interviewTranscription.applied: Copied to the scorecard. Review it and submit it yourself.
interviewTranscription.appliedKeptRating: Evidence copied; your existing rating was kept.
interviewTranscription.notesTruncated: The notes reached their limit: part of the evidence was not copied.
interviewTranscription.degraded: The analysis is incomplete: review the transcript directly.
interviewTranscription.errorBudget: The organization's AI budget for this month has been reached.
interviewTranscription.errorAiUnavailable: AI is not available right now. Try again later.
interviewTranscription.errorTranscriptNotReady: The transcript is not available yet.
interviewTranscription.errorForbidden: You do not have access to this interview's transcript.
